info.name: AA Print N Tags — Complete API
info.description:
## Complete API Collection — AA PRINT N TAGS

### Setup
1. Select an **Environment** (Localhost or UAT) from the top-right dropdown.
2. Run **🔐 Auth → Login as Admin** or **Login as Tenant User** — the token is auto-saved.
3. All create requests auto-capture IDs (`tenantId`, `customerId`, `orderId`, etc.) into collection variables for chained calls.

### Environments
- **Localhost** → `http://localhost:8080/api`
- **UAT** → `http://140.245.210.80/api`

### Default Credentials
| Username | Password | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `admin` | `admin123` | ADMIN (all tenants) |
| `aapnt_user` | `user123` | MANAGER (AA PRINT N TAGS) |

### 🚀 Full Journey (Collection Runner)
Open the **🚀 Full Journey** folder in Collection Runner to simulate a complete PO → Invoice → Payment cycle in one click.

item.name: 🚀 Full Journey (Collection Runner)
item.description:
Run all 8 steps via **Collection Runner** to simulate a complete PO → Invoice → Payment cycle.

Set Iterations (e.g. 5) to create 5 complete journeys back-to-back.

**Pre-requisites:** Login first (Step 1 does it automatically).
